statement: The record shows an active employee with a USD 6,200 monthly payment, but the listed bank account holder is K. Lindqvist rather than J. Okafor, which is a discrepancy.
judge_text:
WRONG

"the listed bank account holder is K. Lindqvist rather than J. Okafor, which is a discrepancy" — it asserts the account-holder value is inconsistent with the employee named in the record.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
